newsitem.title: CHINA: Daewoo to join $190 mln China building deal-Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to join $190 mln China building deal-Xinhua.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Group has signed a preliminary agreement to join a Sino-Korean group in constructing a $190 million commercial building in north China, the official Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
It was unclear which Daewoo company would join the project. The Daewoo Group includes listed Daewoo Corp.
Daewoo's partners in the project in the northeastern Chinese city of Tianjin would be the Tianjin Development Zone Co Ltd and the city government of the South Korean city of Inchon, Xinhua said.
The agency said the three sides would form the Tianjin-Inchon Development Co to undertake the construction. It gave no further financial details.
The 51-storey building would consist of offices, residential apartments, retail shops and an exhibition centre. No timetable for construction was given.
